resources.string: Track attendance, calculate wages & advances, and export PDF reports in one tap.

🔨 Ommali — Manage Workers, Attendance & Payroll with Ease
Ommali helps workshop owners, contractors, and project managers organize their workers, track attendance, and calculate dues — all in one place, replacing paper logs and manual calculations.
📋 Attendance Tracking • Record daily attendance and absence for each worker. • Keep a full history of previous attendance records. • View attendance status for all registered workers each day.
💰 Wages, Advances & Dues • Calculate each worker's dues based on days present. • Record advances and withdrawals and track the remaining balance. • Support for overtime calculation with flexible multipliers or a custom amount.
📊 Clear Reports • Generate monthly PDF attendance and payroll reports. • Easily share reports with your partner or accountant.
🔍 Search & Organize Workers • Search for workers by name or profession. • Filter workers by attendance status. • Categorize workers by trade — craftsman, assistant, blacksmith, and more.
📍 Job Site Management • Log each worker's daily work location. • Save previously used sites for quick reuse. • Perfect for managing workers across multiple sites.
☁️ Cloud Backup • Back up your data securely to Google Drive. • Restore your data anytime or when switching phones.
🔔 Attendance Reminder Enable a daily reminder to help you record your workers' attendance on time.
🎯 Built for Workshop & Site Owners Ommali is designed for carpentry, metalwork, plumbing, and electrical workshop owners, construction and finishing contractors, and any employer managing a team of workers.
🆓 Start Free Enjoy all Ommali features free for 14 days — no feature restrictions. During the trial, you can manage workers, record attendance, track dues and advances, generate reports, and try all the app's tools.
After the trial period, you can subscribe to continue using the app.
🔒 Your Privacy Matters Your data is stored securely, and you can create your own personal backup on Google Drive. We do not sell or share user data with third parties for advertising purposes.
Ommali — Organize your workers, track their attendance, and calculate their dues with ease.
